description: Use this when you need to insert a new feature line into a script. Insert a new feature line into a kernelCAD script before the last top-level return statement. Returns the modified code as text plus diagnostics from re-evaluating the result. Direct editing is authored here too: use `body.deleteFace(faces)` to heal a removed-face opening, or `body.replaceFace(faces, { origin, normal })` for a parallel planar replacement; the runtime refuses any result that does not pass its single-solid BRepCheck gate. Primitives that accept faceLabels (box, cylinder, extrudeRect, extrudeCircle, extrudePolygon, extrudeRoundedRect) can receive `opts.faceLabels` in the inserted code — use `lookup_api` to see `featureKindFaceLabels` for the full value schema.

feature_code.description: Single-statement source line to insert (e.g. `const hole = cylinder(5, 2).translate(10, 10, -1);`).
